verdict.rationale: Antigravity ships a Python Agent SDK and a headless CLI, so asking whether it publishes a machine-readable API spec is a fair question. However, the evidence documents no OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and a probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404. The llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation for LLMs, not an API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
